details:
The package executes a hidden loader (`_platform.js`) when it is imported. The loader downloads an operating-system-specific native executable from attacker-controlled Cloudflare Workers hosts, writes it to a temporary location, and starts it as a detached process. If HTTPS delivery fails, it reconstructs the executable from Base64-encoded DNS TXT records under `wel1.ru`.

The loader shares code, Workers infrastructure, and the DNS TXT fallback technique with the `pfp-forms-sme-loan` and `tinkoff-statist-browser-typed-client-sme.reporting.reporting` npm packages. The recovered final payloads in this cluster are Sliver C2 implants. Systems that imported this package should be considered compromised; rotate secrets accessible from those systems and investigate temporary-file execution and DNS activity to the listed infrastructure.

cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
